header.name: [bedrock-research]inventory-ui-enhanced-components-rp_v1.0.0
header.description: v1.0.0 - Component window added to the vanilla chest panel and picked by the container title. Each page is a panel shown when the page key in a slot name matches, and each component is drawn with Ore UI sizes and colors. Vanilla chest parts are hidden only by bindings inserted with modifications that read the shared entity_ui_hide_vanilla marker.
